_doc: Synthetic fixture set for the rpa-session-creation-timeout scenario (job-faulted-session-timeout playbook). The agent derives keys by chaining: folders list -> jobs list --state Faulted -> jobs get -> jobs logs -> jobs history -> machines list. The discriminating evidence is the 'Creating user session timed out' string with NO logon-failure code (rules out job-faulted-logon-failure) plus a ~120s Running-then-Faulted history (rules out no-host/Pending) — a session-creation timeout from host latency. The Robot version 23.4.7 on RECON-BOT-01 is a data point, NOT the cause (no version-specific fix). Specific rules precede generic ones so first-match-wins picks the narrower fixture.

rules._doc: Proxy any docsai query to the real uip CLI; query strings vary between runs so canned responses go stale. Optional corroboration step in the playbook - an empty/failed KB result is not disconfirming.

unmocked_default._doc: Permissive fallback: any uip command not matched above returns an empty array so the agent can explore beyond the recorded path without aborting.
